office_does: The clerk keeps the superior court's records and exhibits, receives and pays out court-ordered money, runs the jury system and handles passports.
race_blurb: Uncontested: longtime Clerk Kathy Martin is retiring, and Chief Deputy Clerk Becky Renwick is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Chief Deputy Clerk and a county employee since 1997, running unopposed to succeed retiring Clerk Kathy Martin.
highlights: County employee since 1997, mostly in the Department of Court Services [S1]
District Court trial clerk, then Chief Deputy Clerk since 2024 [S1]
Only candidate after Clerk Kathy Martin (38 years) did not run [S3]
